bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a grant to renovate the historic Wayzata Section House and convert it into a Lakeshore Learning Center.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; WAYZATA SECTION HOUSE. +]

[+$641,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of Wayzata to renovate the historic Wayzata Section House and convert it to a Lakeshore Learning Center. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a grant to renovate the historic Wayzata Section House and convert it into a Lakeshore Learning Center.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WAYZATA SECTION HOUSE.

$641,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of Wayzata to renovate the historic Wayzata Section House and convert it to a Lakeshore Learning Center.
additions: $641,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of Wayzata to renovate the historic Wayzata Section House and convert it to a Lakeshore Learning Center.
